worked_solution:
The matrix of our system is

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1\end{aligned}].
$$

Notice that:

- Since the only (repeated) eigenvalue of $A$ is $\lambda =-1$ and it's negative, we have a $\text{stable}$ node.

- Since $A$ is diagonal and has a repeated eigenvalue, there are infinitely many linearly independent eigenvectors. So, we have a $\text{star}$ node.

**Note:** The phase portrait of the system looks as follows:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069697/assets/92efcce675a436ad349ca6139cb12cda88fbdd5bdeaf2a5f1e755e7ba1f6d037.png)
